audience: marketers and developers who send campaigns and transactional email with Enginemailer

useCases.title: Look up a subscriber by email
useCases.text: Finds a subscriber by email and shows the status and all custom field values. Custom field definitions can be listed too.

useCases.title: Check campaign results or list unsent campaigns
useCases.text: Reads the results of a delivered campaign: sent, delivered, bounces, opens, clicks, unsubscribes and spam complaints. Also lists drafts and scheduled campaigns.

useCases.title: Add, update or unsubscribe a subscriber
useCases.text: Adds a subscriber with subcategories and custom fields, changes subcategories or custom fields, or unsubscribes a person from campaigns.

useCases.title: Create a campaign, pick recipients and send it
useCases.text: Creates a campaign draft, sets recipients to all subscribers or to chosen subcategories, and sends it now. Sending cannot be undone.

useCases.title: Send a transactional email to one person
useCases.text: Sends one transactional email now to one recipient, with optional CC and BCC. It needs a sender address set up in Enginemailer.

useCases.title: Export the transactional email report
useCases.text: Starts a CSV export of the transactional delivery report for a period of up to 60 days back, then checks it and gives the download link when done.
